    const float Vref1 = Vbeta;
    const float Vref2 = (SQRT3 * Valpha - Vbeta) * 0.5f;
    const float Vref3 = (-SQRT3 * Valpha - Vbeta) * 0.5f;

        2,  /* 001 */
        6,  /* 010 */
        1,  /* 011 */
        4,  /* 100 */
        3,  /* 101 */
        5   /* 110 */
    };

    if (sector < 1) sector = 1;
    if (sector > 6) sector = 6;
